confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Bogota prices; no live price pages or listings were checked. Restaurant and bar anchors are moderately certain (roughly +/-30 percent). Hotel and hostel rates are least certain, and mid-year holiday demand is not modelled. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer relationship (about 3.2x and 2.8x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. FX 0.6955 for 2026-10-15 comes from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA statistics page. Later searches could not confirm it, and one reached only a March 2026 RBA snapshot, so verify against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is general Colombian and Andean urban price levels, benchmarked loosely against Medellin and Lima for meals and hostels and against mid-sized Latin American capitals for hotels.
